metadata.title: [FX] getattr default not respected after symbolic_trace

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



Is during symbolic tracing a builtin.getattr is traced and it uses a default value, that default value is lost.

trigger_conditions.condition: Tracing modules containing dynamic Python attribute access such as getattr with default values may lose original semantics during graph transformation, causing execution differences between original and traced models.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: A traced nn.Module forward calls builtins.getattr on a Tensor attribute that does not exist and supplies a default value, e.g. getattr(a, 'nonexistent_attr', torch.Size([1,2])).

failure_behavior.description: A traced nn.Module forward calls builtins.getattr on a Tensor attribute that does not exist and supplies a default value, e.g. getattr(a, 'nonexistent_attr', torch.Size([1,2])).
